name: Raid bots: a tank keeps swinging at the encounter boss while a healer heals it
contract: Roles act only while an encounter is active, so every bot action follows encounter_start. Classes and spells
are CoA class baselines (src/server/coa/AscensionLiveBaselineData.h): Barbarian (class 12) row {12, 0, 801576}
Ancestral Strike for the tank, Sun Cleric (class 27) row {27, 0, 500143} Illumination for the healer. Both
are the first ranks at level 2 (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h: next ranks 802444 at level 8 and 502421 at
level 6), and the same spells drive timeline-player-casts and sun-cleric-solar-power-resource. Client
Spell.dbc (coa-dbc-viewer record against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset): Illumination casts in 2000 ms
(SpellCastTimes 5), 40 yd range (SpellRange 5), 30 percent base mana, 1500 ms global cooldown, no facing
flag; Ancestral Strike is instant, 35 Energy, melee range (SpellRange 2), facing required. The tank wields
a Worn Shortsword (item_template 25, delay 1900 ms), so 20000 ms of auto attack allows about ten swings and
at least five survive the setup of the first swing. The tank is set to half health at engage, below the
90 percent heal threshold, so at least one Illumination completes within the 20000 ms window. The level-2
defensive fixture cannot drop a 500-of-1000-health tank to zero in that time while being healed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and local level scaling settle
SETUP: the tank knows its rotation spell
SETUP: the healer knows its heal
CONTROL: no melee swing before the encounter
The tank kept swinging at the boss
The healer completed at least one heal
Every heal went to the injured tank
